maps_card_loading_notes.description: Accessibility label while a map card's description is loading.

maps_current_location.description: A route stop at the supplied current location, without business details.

maps_open_in_maps.description: Opens a route stop in the native maps app.

maps_open_route.description: Button that opens the complete itinerary in an external maps app.

maps_place_actions.description: Accessibility label for the route stop action menu.

maps_place_closed.description: Business availability when a place is currently closed.

maps_place_closes_at.description: Next closing transition. The value is a localized clock time. The Markdown-emphasized availability is colored in the UI.

maps_place_closes_on.description: Next closing transition. The value is a localized full weekday name. The Markdown-emphasized availability is colored in the UI.

maps_place_open.description: Business availability when a place is currently open.

maps_place_opens_at.description: Next opening transition. The value is a localized clock time. The Markdown-emphasized availability is colored in the UI.

maps_place_opens_on.description: Next opening transition. The value is a localized full weekday name. The Markdown-emphasized availability is colored in the UI.

maps_place_permanently_closed.description: Business availability when a place has permanently closed.

maps_place_photo.description: Accessibility label for a photo in the route stop gallery.

maps_route_apple_version_limit.defaultMessage: iOS {version} அல்லது அதற்குப் பிந்தைய பதிப்பில் மட்டுமே இந்த வழித்தடத்தை Apple Maps-இல் திறக்கலாம்.
maps_route_apple_version_limit.description: Explains the OS version required for complete route handoff.
maps_route_apple_version_limit.example: Opening this route in Apple Maps requires iOS 18.4 or later.

maps_route_google_stop_limit.defaultMessage: Google Maps-இல் அதிகபட்சம் {limit} நிறுத்தங்களைக் கொண்ட வழித்தடத்தைத் திறக்கலாம். இந்த வழித்தடம் முழுவதையும் திறக்க Apple Maps-ஐப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
maps_route_google_stop_limit.description: Explains a provider limit for this itinerary, including start and destination.
maps_route_google_stop_limit.example: Google Maps can open up to 10 stops. Use Apple Maps to open this entire route.

maps_route_stops.description: Accessibility label for the duration button that opens the ordered route stops.

maps_share_place.description: Accessibility label for sharing a route stop.

maps_view_place.description: Opens the details for a route stop.

maps_visit_website.description: Opens the website for a route stop.
